title: Kill the N+1 in an order report
acceptanceCriteria: A page of 50 orders costs exactly one customer query
Concurrent `load` calls each get the customer they asked for, whatever order the database returns rows in
A load for a deleted customer resolves to `null`, and the report shows `(deleted customer)` without shifting the other rows
Each customer id is sent at most once per batch
The report includes every order, even though one `listOrders` call returns at most 1,000 rows
